From Student to Success Story

At Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland, every journey begins with a dream - and ends with mastery, confidence, and global opportunity. Our graduates don't just cook; they create, lead, and inspire. From Michelin-starred kitchens to entrepreneurial ventures, they're shaping the future of gastronomy across continents.

Carlos

From studying architecture in Los Angeles to mastering plating in a 2-star Michelin kitchen in Barcelona, Carlos followed his heart to Switzerland. Today, he's on a path to open his own fine-dining restaurant, blending Mexican heritage with global techniques learned at Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland.

Salman

Qatar - World Cup service, five-star restaurant (600+ covers/day)

Salman refined his skills at a leading five-star restaurant in Doha, serving over 600 guests daily during the World Cup. His education at Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland empowered him to dream bigger - to one day earn Qatar's first Michelin star and lead his own culinary team.

Starting with no kitchen experience, Donya rose to become Saudi Arabia's youngest sous chef - and a recognized voice for women in hospitality. Her Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland training and mentorship gave her the confidence to turn passion into purpose - and to lead change in her country's culinary scene.

Three-Step Application Process

01

Apply Online

  1. Register
  2. Check your email & create your password
  3. Login to complete your application and include the documents listed below:
  • High school or university transcript / diploma / certificate
  • Proof of English proficiency – TOEFL, IELTS, or equivalent
  • Passport copy
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Motivation letter (500 words minimum)
  • Reference letters (if applicable)

Documents must be translated into English by an official translator. Copies are accepted, however original documents may be requested.

After you submit your application, we will send you a confirmation email that includes a link to pay your application fee.

Application fee: CHF 150
02

Acceptance

  1. The admissions office will review your application. If you have met the requirements and displayed motivation for the requested program, a provisional letter of acceptance will be sent.
  2. Accepted applicants who applied by 13 December 2026 and successfully passed their online interview will be considered for the Early Bird Scholarship: your application fee waived.
  3. To secure your enrollment, the confirmation fee must be paid within 30 days and will be applied toward your first term fees.
  4. Cancelation insurance is optional.
Confirmation fee: CHF 3,000  ·  Optional cancelation insurance: CHF 310
03

Confirmation and Visa Application

  1. After your payment, you will receive your enrollment letter to apply for your visa (if applicable).*
  2. The remaining balance of the first term fees must be received six weeks before your start date. Any special room requests (first-come basis) can only be confirmed once full payment is received.

*For non-EU students, you will need to apply for a student visa at the nearest Swiss Embassy or Consulate in your home country with your confirmation letter and proof of payment. The final decision is made by Swiss authorities and can take up to 12 weeks.
